title: Tilted Mesh And Rear U Stand Rebounder
description: One newly authored complete static portable tilted mesh rebounder appearance. A continuous rounded tubular perimeter surrounds a true open crossed-cord net with its own continuous edge cord and short visible perimeter tension ties. Two front feet and one complete rear U support with two rear pads ground the frame; paired side stays and whole pivot collars root the support. Every frame contour, net span, support and tie is newly authored for this whole object, not an old solid passing board with transparency, an extracted cage panel or a rescaled tennis net. Four opaque constant PBR roles, metre units, Z up; one whole prop and zero scenes. Empty static illustrative equipment only: no tension, elasticity, impact, trajectory, ball-return performance, adjustability, user fit, sports regulation, loading, manufacture or safety claim.
